title: Barcode scanner intermittently disconnects from WMS
content: Warehouse scanners (Zebra TC52) intermittently lose connection to the WMS (Warehouse Management System) during peak hours 2-4PM. Error on device: 'Session timeout — reconnecting'. Investigation: Wi-Fi channel saturation on 2.4GHz band in warehouse zone B. Resolution: Migrate scanners to 5GHz SSID 'NexusWH-5G' and update WMS session timeout from 300s to 900s in wms-config.xml.

title: ERP login fails for new hires
content: New employees provisioned after 2024-05-01 cannot log into the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA). Error: 'User account not found in authorization group ZLOGISTIC'. Root cause: Automated provisioning script missing ZLOGISTIC role assignment. Fix: Added ZLOGISTIC to the default role template in the IAM provisioning workflow. Backfill: IT ran bulk role assignment for 23 affected users on 2024-05-15.

title: Nightly ETL job failing with memory error
content: The nightly ETL job (job ID: ETL-NF-042) fails at 02:30 UTC with OutOfMemoryError in the transform stage. Log: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded in NexusETLTransformer.java:384. Fix: Increased JVM heap from 4GB to 8GB in etl-runner.sh (JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx8g). Also enabled incremental processing to avoid loading full daily delta in memory.

title: SSL certificate expiry on logistics API gateway
content: The SSL certificate for api.nexus-freight.example.com expired on 2024-06-01 causing 503 errors for all external partners. Emergency fix: Renewed certificate via Let's Encrypt certbot. Permanent fix: Added certificate expiry monitoring to Zabbix with 30-day and 7-day alerts. Added auto-renewal via cron: '0 3 * * * certbot renew --quiet'.

title: Warehouse Scanner Setup and Troubleshooting
content: Standard setup for Zebra TC52 scanners: 1) Connect to SSID 'NexusWH-5G' (password in IT password vault under 'WarehouseWifi'). 2) Launch WMS app — icon is a blue barcode. 3) If session timeout errors occur, check wms-config.xml session_timeout value should be 900. 4) If scanner shows 'Certificate error' update the root CA bundle via MDM push. 5) Factory reset procedure: hold Power + Volume-Down for 10 seconds.
